info.title: Migrondi
info.description:
This is a simple SQL migrations tool
          Write your Migration SQL apply them or revert them from your database.

options.name: --connection
options.description: The connection string to the database.

options.name: --migrations
options.description: The path to the migrations directory.

options.name: --table-name
options.description: The name of the table that will store the migrations.

options.name: --driver
options.description: The driver that will be used to connect to the database.
